summary: Engagement Tracker (Webhook Receiver) testing complete. All 30 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend page loads correctly with stats cards, charts, Live Events feed, and Webhook Setup configuration for all 5 platforms.
critical_code_review_comments: All backend API endpoints are working correctly with proper JWT authentication
Webhook verification endpoints (no auth) work for all 5 platforms following their specs
Event receiver endpoints process events and store them in social_webhook_events collection
Engagement summary aggregates events by type and platform correctly
Test/simulate endpoints create realistic mock events for development testing
Stats cards correctly show counts from summary API
Charts render engagement data by type (pie) and by platform (bar)
Live Events tab shows event feed with platform icons and timestamps
Webhook Setup tab shows URLs and setup instructions for all 5 platforms
Navigation link present at /social/engagement under Social Media section
seed_data_creation: Test events created via POST /api/social/webhooks/events/{platform} and POST /api/social/webhooks/test/{platform} endpoints. Events stored in social_webhook_events collection.
